card.name: Linking words before pharmacology and CNS terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'and', 'the', 'is' or "'s" in drug labels, right before an expected word like pharmacologically, CNS effects, cognitive, motor or anticholinergic. Also partway through words like pharmac- and neuro-.

modes.description: A short word such as 'and', 'the' or "'s" that comes right before a pharmacological or CNS-effect word.
